About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and help build impactful ML solutions across a variety of real-world business and product use cases. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving practical problems with machine learning and has hands-on experience building models that drive measurable outcomes.

You'll work on initiatives such as recommendation systems, sales forecasting, upselling and cross-selling, cart-level intelligence, personalization, and customer behavior modeling and you'll be expected to take projects all the way from idea to production.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Recommendation systems to improve personalization and discovery
  • Sales and demand forecasting models
  • Upsell and cross-sell use cases
  • Cart / basket intelligence and purchase behavior analysis
  • Customer segmentation, targeting, and predictive modeling
  • ML-driven solutions that improve product experience and business performance

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, build, deploy, and optimize ML models for a range of product and business use cases
  • Translate business requirements into practical ML solutions with clear success metrics
  • Gather, clean, and analyze data for training, evaluation, and experimentation
  • Build scalable feature pipelines and production-ready model workflows
  • Deploy ML models into production environments for batch or real-time use cases
  • Monitor model performance, data quality, drift, and business outcomes
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize ML opportunities
  • Continuously improve models and workflows based on results, feedback, and changing business needs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong Python skills with solid ML fundamentals model evaluation, feature engineering, and experimentation
  • Proven experience building and deploying ML models in production
  • Hands-on experience with applied ML use cases such as recommendations, forecasting, targeting, or optimization
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills
  • Familiarity with Docker and AWS
  • Ability to handle end-to-end ML projects independently
  • Strong communication skills and a practical, problem-solving mindset

NICE TO HAVE

– Experience with recommendation systems and personalization

– Experience with sales forecasting, demand prediction, or time-series models

– Experience with upsell / cross-sell models or cart analysis

– Domain experience in food delivery, e-commerce, retail, or marketplace platforms

– Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or similar frameworks

– Exposure to experimentation and A/B testing


WHO YOU ARE

  • Proactive, curious, and execution-focused
  • Passionate about applied machine learning and solving real business problems
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas simply to non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a broader team

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Python, SQL
  • pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn
  • XGBoost, LightGBM
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow
  • Docker, AWS, Git

– Exposure to Airflow, MLflow, FastAPI, Spark, or similar data / ML infrastructure is a plus

    • Experience building AI chat assistants / conversational agents
